en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Salma Bin Al Khattab, from Al Husayn Bin Sayf, from Muhammad Bin Yaya, from Hajjaj Al Khashhab, from Abu Al Fawaris who said,
‘Abu Abdullahasws forbade us to speak in between the four Rak’at of Salāt which are after Al-Maghrib’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Salmah ibn al-Khattab from al-Husayn ibn Sayf from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Hajjaj al- Khashshab from abu al-Fawaris who has said the following: “
Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, prohibited me from speaking between the four Rak‘at after al- Maghrib.”
